note: A salaried software designer, not a business owner or physician, so he misses the ICP's occupation test even though he is plainly a capable professional. He misses income harder: $1,500 available, roughly $400 a month spare, a 401k he cannot touch, and 'that might be a little out of my range.' He fits everything else - health is the one neglected area, he is not deconditioned (former gym-goer, gardener, owns kettlebells), and he wants to build on a base rather than be rescued. A clean example of the icp.json observation that income screening filters out prospects a payment plan might otherwise carry.
